items.title: Josh Jacobs: Status up in air for Week 7
items.text:
Jacobs remains uncertain to play Sunday at Detroit, with head coach Matt LaFleur saying, "We'll see. We'll work through it," Rob Demovsky of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyjae Spears: Spectator to begin practice week
items.text:
